title: SM-16.11 - What happens when external-user surveys become read-only
intent: This article answers: SM-16.11 - What happens when external-user surveys become read-only
short_answer: When external-user surveys switch to read-only mode, they cannot be edited, published surveys are automatically unpublished, and no new responses can be collected. Surveys remain accessible for consultation and data export until final closure.
important_conditions: Users should export their data before final closure.
